You are FIXING a short WhatsApp quiz written for the children who sat in ONE real lesson. 1 of its 8 questions were rejected by our checks. You are writing ONE replacement for each. Every other question is good and is staying exactly as it is — do not touch it, do not return it.

QUIZ LANGUAGE: Urdu. Write EVERYTHING in Urdu script; keep English technical terms in English letters exactly as the teacher used them.

REWRITE THESE QUESTIONS: q7

WHAT THESE CHILDREN WERE MEANT TO LEARN. A replacement stays on its own question's SLO, at its own question's level.
- S1 [taught at apply] طلباء فروخت سے حاصل ہونے والی کل کمائی کا حساب لگانے کے لیے multiplication استعمال کریں گے۔
- S2 [taught at apply] طلباء اخراجات کے بعد منافع کا حساب لگانے کے لیے subtraction استعمال کریں گے۔
- S3 [taught at apply] طلباء شراکت داروں کے درمیان منافع کو یکساں طور پر تقسیم کرنے کے لیے division استعمال کریں گے۔
- S4 [taught at apply] طلباء دو decimal places تک کے اعشاریہ رقم کے حقیقی دنیا کے word problems حل کریں گے۔

THE LESSON'S OWN MATERIAL — dress the replacement in it, so a child recognises the class in the quiz.
topic as the teacher named it: Connect & Create: Lemonade Stand Profit Calculation
the lesson's own examples: Ali & Sana: 16 samosa plates at Rs 15.50 each. Calculate earnings, profit after 100.50 investment, and share profit between 2 partners.; Cups sold: 15 (morning) + 8 (afternoon), at Rs 30.5 each. Find the total earnings.; Total earnings Rs 701.50; investment Rs 450.75. Find the profit.; Profit Rs 250.75, shared equally by 2 partners. What goes in the blank (before splitting)?
the words used in class: multiplication, subtraction, division, earnings, profit, decimal money amounts, word problem, operations

THE QUESTIONS THAT ARE STAYING. A replacement must not ask one of these again, and must not have the same answer as one of them.
  q0: اگر ایک چیز کی قیمت Rs 15.50 ہے اور آپ کو ایسی 16 چیزیں خریدنی ہوں تو کون سا operation استعمال کرنا چاہیے؟
  q1: علی اور ثناء نے 16 samosa plates بیچی ہیں، ہر ایک Rs 15.50 کی ہے۔ ان کی کل earnings کتنی ہیں؟
  q2: اگر علی اور ثناء کی کل earnings Rs 248.00 ہیں اور ان کی investment کی رقم Rs 100.50 ہے تو ان کا profit کتنا ہے؟
  q3: اگر علی اور ثناء کا profit کی رقم Rs 147.50 ہے اور وہ اسے 2 شراکت داروں میں برابر تقسیم کرتے ہیں تو ہر ایک کو کتنے روپے ملیں گے؟
  q4: تصویر میں کل کتنے کپ ہیں؟
  q5: اگر کل earnings Rs 701.50 ہیں اور investment کی رقم Rs 450.75 ہے تو profit معلوم کرنے کے لیے کون سا operation استعمال ہوگا؟
  q6: اگر profit کی رقم Rs 250.75 ہے اور اسے 2 شراکت داروں میں برابر تقسیم کرنا ہے تو کون سا operation استعمال ہوگا؟

EVERY QUESTION TESTS SOMETHING NO OTHER QUESTION TESTS. No two questions in the quiz may have the same correct answer on the same fact: the same question with its options in another order, with other wrong options, or with a few words added or changed is the SAME question, and a child would answer it twice. A question shape may be used again only with different numbers or a different item from the lesson (round 18, then round 16; the article before "kite", then before "tree"), so that its correct answer is different too. Before you return, read the questions side by side: where two test the same thing, write a question on something else in place of the later one, keeping the number of questions as it is.

REJECTED — write one new question for each, except a question marked REPAIR IN PLACE: return that one as it stands, with only the words its complaints name changed.

q7 · slo_id "S4" · level "apply"
  the question being thrown away: "ایک دکان میں 20 کپ Rs 30.5 فی کپ کے حساب سے فروخت ہوئے۔ اگر دکان کا کرایہ Rs 150.00 تھا تو دکان کا profit کتنا ہوا؟"
  its options were: Rs 460.00 | Rs 610.00 | Rs 760.00
  why it was rejected:
    - q7: KEY_CONFLICT — the answer marked correct ("Rs 460.00") contradicts the lesson, which says: "Multiply for earnings, subtract for profit, divide only when sharing.". Mark as correct the answer the lesson teaches; the lesson's mistake may only ever …(+12511)
